description: This file defines a Java class 'CommonServices' that provides a collection of static service methods for the Apache OFBiz framework. The methods include service utilities, transaction tests, entity creation, system diagnostics, and metrics handling, among others.

classes.name: CommonServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static service methods related to system diagnostics, entity management, transaction testing, metrics, and miscellaneous utilities within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: testService
methods.description: Returns a success response and logs the input context entries.

methods.name: testSOAPService
methods.description: Creates and returns dummy testing nodes for SOAP service testing.

methods.name: blockingTestService
methods.description: Simulates a blocking service by sleeping for a specified duration, then calls testService.

methods.name: testRollbackListener
methods.description: Registers a rollback service and returns an error message indicating a rollback test.

methods.name: testCommitListener
methods.description: Registers a commit service and returns success.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note record linked to a party or user login, with optional timestamp.

methods.name: adjustDebugLevels
methods.description: Sets different debug levels based on input parameters.

methods.name: forceGc
methods.description: Invokes garbage collection.

methods.name: echoService
methods.description: Echoes back input parameters with success response.

methods.name: returnErrorService
methods.description: Returns an error message for testing error handling.

methods.name: conditionTrueService
methods.description: Returns a success response with condition reply true.

methods.name: conditionFalseService
methods.description: Returns a success response with condition reply false.

methods.name: entityFailTest
methods.description: Attempts to create an entity with invalid data to cause a referential integrity error.

methods.name: entitySortTest
methods.description: Retrieves model entities, adds them to a sorted set, and logs their names.

methods.name: makeALotOfVisits
methods.description: Creates a specified number of Visit entities for load testing.

methods.name: displayXaDebugInfo
methods.description: Logs transaction resource debugging information.

methods.name: byteBufferTest
methods.description: Writes contents of ByteBuffers to files.

methods.name: uploadTest
methods.description: Handles file upload, creating data resource and content entries.

methods.name: mcaTest
methods.description: Logs details of an email MimeMessage.

methods.name: streamTest
methods.description: Reads input stream line by line, logs, and writes to output stream.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Checks database sequence table count and returns a pong message or error.

methods.name: getAllMetrics
methods.description: Returns current metrics information.

methods.name: resetMetric
methods.description: Decodes metric name from URL, resets the respective metric if found.
